import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from jax import random
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# --- Quaero I's (and Veritas III's) CPE Generator & ContextEncoder (copied directly) ---
class ContextEncoder(nn.Module):
    output_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, local_context_window):
        flat_context = local_context_window.reshape(local_context_window.shape[0], -1)
        encoded_context = nn.Dense(self.output_dim, name='context_dense')(flat_context)
        encoded_context = nn.gelu(encoded_context)
        return encoded_context

class CPE_Generator(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    pos_embedding_dim: int = 16
    context_window_size: int = 3
    max_overall_seq_len: int = 1200
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_raw):
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = x_raw.shape
        positional_embeddings_table = self.param(
            'pos_embeddings_table', nn.initializers.normal(stddev=0.01),
            (self.max_overall_seq_len, self.pos_embedding_dim)
        )
        pad_width = self.context_window_size // 2
        padded_x = jnp.pad(x_raw, ((0,0), (pad_width, pad_width), (0,0)), mode='constant', constant_values=0.0)
        all_windows_flat = jnp.stack(
            [padded_x[:, i : i + self.context_window_size, :].reshape(batch_size, -1) for i in range(seq_len)],
            axis=1
        )
        context_encoder = ContextEncoder(output_dim=self.pos_embedding_dim, name='context_encoder')
        encoded_contexts_batched = context_encoder(all_windows_flat.reshape(-1, self.context_window_size * self.d_input)).reshape(batch_size, seq_len, -1)
        current_pos_embeddings_sliced = positional_embeddings_table[:seq_len]
        current_pos_embeddings_batched = jnp.tile(current_pos_embeddings_sliced[None, :, :], (batch_size, 1, 1))
        cpe_raw_signals = current_pos_embeddings_batched * encoded_contexts_batched
        return cpe_raw_signals

# --- Quaero I's ResidualDSConvBlock (copied directly from ID 888) ---
class ResidualDSConvBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    kernel_size: int
    dilation: int
    dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic: bool = True):
        residual = x
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        dw_out = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model,
                         kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
                         feature_group_count=self.d_model,
                         kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,),
                         padding='SAME',
                         name='dw_conv')(h)
        dw_out = nn.gelu(dw_out)
        pw_out = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(dw_out)
        pw_out = nn.gelu(pw_out)
        pw_out_dropout = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(pw_out, deterministic=deterministic)
        return residual + pw_out_dropout

# --- Quaero I's DeepCPE_Gated_ResidualDSConvBlock (copied directly from ID 909) ---
class DeepCPE_Gated_ResidualDSConvBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    cpe_signals: Any  # (batch, seq_len, pos_embedding_dim)
    kernel_size: int = 7
    dilation: int = 1
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1
    pos_embedding_dim: int = 16
    gate_intermediate_dim: int = 64

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        residual = x
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)

        # Standard DSConv operations
        dw_out = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
                         feature_group_count=self.d_model, padding='SAME',
                         kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,), name='dw_conv')(h)
        dw_out = nn.gelu(dw_out)
        h_conv_output = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(dw_out)
        # h_conv_output is now (batch, seq_len, d_model)

        # --- LEARNED GATING MECHANISM ---
        # 1. Project CPE signals to match d_model
        cpe_projected = nn.Dense(self.d_model, name='cpe_proj_for_gate')(self.cpe_signals)
        cpe_projected = nn.gelu(cpe_projected)

        # 2. Combine intermediate features (h_conv_output) and projected CPE
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([h_conv_output, cpe_projected], axis=-1)

        # 3. Gate Logic: Dense -> GELU -> Dense -> Sigmoid
        gate_input = nn.Dense(self.gate_intermediate_dim, name='gate_dense_1')(combined_features)
        gate_input = nn.gelu(gate_input)
        gate_output_raw = nn.Dense(self.d_model, name='gate_dense_2')(gate_input)
        gate_factor = nn.sigmoid(gate_output_raw) # Element-wise sigmoid activation

        # 4. Modulate the convolutional output
        modulated_h = h_conv_output * gate_factor
        # --- END LEARNED GATING ---

        # Apply dropout to the modulated features before residual add
        modulated_h_dropout = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(modulated_h, deterministic=deterministic)

        return residual + modulated_h_dropout

# --- Praxis I's SiameseInteractionHead (copied directly from ID 897) ---
class SiameseInteractionHead(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    dense_dim: int = 64
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1 # This will be set by global dropout_rate from hparams
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_sgrna, x_target, deterministic: bool = True):
        # x_sgrna and x_target are (batch, d_model)
        
        # Feature transformation (separate Dense layers for sgRNA and target)
        sgrna_proj = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='sgrna_proj')(x_sgrna)
        sgrna_proj = nn.gelu(sgrna_proj)
        sgrna_proj = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(sgrna_proj, deterministic=deterministic)

        target_proj = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='target_proj')(x_target)
        target_proj = nn.gelu(target_proj)
        target_proj = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(target_proj, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Interaction features: difference and product
        diff = jnp.abs(sgrna_proj - target_proj)
        prod = sgrna_proj * target_proj

        # Fuse interaction features
        interaction_features = jnp.concatenate([diff, prod], axis=-1) # (batch, 2 * dense_dim)
        interaction_features = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='interaction_fusion')(interaction_features)
        interaction_features = nn.gelu(interaction_features)
        interaction_features = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(interaction_features, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Final prediction
        logits = nn.Dense(1, name='output_logits')(interaction_features)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) # Squeeze for regression output

# --- Quaero I's Prediction Heads (for non-CRI-Off tasks) ---
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; dense_dim: int; dropout_rate: float; l2_norm_input: bool
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        if self.l2_norm_input:
            norm = jnp.linalg.norm(x, ord=2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            x = x / (norm + 1e-6)
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        return nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z).squeeze(-1)

class GenericHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; dense_dim: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        return nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)

# --- Main Network: Aether's Synthesis of Quaero + Praxis ---
class Aether_QuaeroCPE_SiameseSynthesisNet(nn.Module):
    # All hyperparameters from Quaero I's ID 909, plus Praxis I's specific ones
    d_output: int; task_type: str; hparams: Dict[str, Any]

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_raw, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Generate CPE signals once from the raw input (as in Quaero I)
        cpe_generator = CPE_Generator(
            d_input=x_raw.shape[-1], # 4
            pos_embedding_dim=self.hparams.get('pos_embedding_dim', 16),
            context_window_size=self.hparams.get('context_window_size', 3),
            max_overall_seq_len=self.hparams.get('max_overall_seq_len', 1200),
            name='cpe_generator'
        )
        cpe_signals = cpe_generator(x_raw)

        # 2. Initial Projection (as in Quaero I)
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model_common'], name="initial_dense")(x_raw)
        h = nn.gelu(h)

        # 3. CPE-Gated Residual Backbone (as in Quaero I)
        for i in range(self.hparams['ds_num_blocks']):
            dilation = self.hparams['ds_dilations'][i] if i < len(self.hparams['ds_dilations']) else self.hparams['ds_dilations'][-1]
            h = DeepCPE_Gated_ResidualDSConvBlock(
                d_model=self.hparams['d_model_common'], kernel_size=self.hparams['ds_kernel_size'],
                dilation=dilation, dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'],
                cpe_signals=cpe_signals, # Pass CPE signals here
                pos_embedding_dim=self.hparams.get('pos_embedding_dim', 16), # Also pass to gated block
                gate_intermediate_dim=self.hparams.get('gate_intermediate_dim', 64), # Also pass to gated block
                name=f"cpe_gated_block_{i}"
            )(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = h # Output of backbone: (batch, seq_len, d_model_common)

        # --- Conditional Head Application ---
        if self.task_type == "CRI-Off":
            # 4. Feature Extraction for Siamese Head
            sgrna_len = self.hparams['sgrna_len']
            # Ensure slicing is robust: assuming sgRNA is at the beginning of the sequence.
            sgRNA_sequence_features = cnn_features[:, :sgrna_len, :] # (batch, sgrna_len, d_model_common)
            target_sequence_features = cnn_features[:, sgrna_len:, :] # (batch, target_len, d_model_common)

            # Apply global mean pooling to get fixed-size representations
            pooled_sgrna_feat = jnp.mean(sgRNA_sequence_features, axis=1) # (batch, d_model_common)
            pooled_target_feat = jnp.mean(target_sequence_features, axis=1) # (batch, d_model_common)

            # 5. Apply Praxis I's SiameseInteractionHead
            siamese_head = SiameseInteractionHead(
                d_model=self.hparams['d_model_common'], # Input feature dim is d_model_common
                dense_dim=self.hparams.get('siamese_head_dense_dim', 64),
                dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'] # Use global dropout from Quaero
            )
            logits = siamese_head(pooled_sgrna_feat, pooled_target_feat, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            # 4. Dual-Path Pooling (as in Quaero I) - Only for non-CRI-Off tasks
            main_path = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1), jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)], axis=-1)
            motif_f = nn.gelu(nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model_common'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME', name='motif_conv_for_pool'))(cnn_features) # Added name
            specialized_path = jnp.max(motif_f, axis=1)
            
            fused_features_for_generic_heads = jnp.concatenate([main_path, specialized_path], axis=-1)
            fused_features_for_generic_heads = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_fused_ln")(fused_features_for_generic_heads)
            fused_features_for_generic_heads = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)
            
            # 5. Task-Specific Heads (as in Quaero I)
            head_args = {
                'd_output': self.d_output, 
                'dense_dim': self.hparams['head_intermediate_dim'], 
                'dropout_rate': self.hparams['dropout_rate']
            }
            if self.task_type == "regression": # For simple regression (APA, CRI-On, MRL)
                regression_head = RegressionHead(**head_args, l2_norm_input=True, name='regression_head') # Added name
                logits = regression_head(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)
            else: # For MultiLabelClassification (Modif, ncRNA) and MultiLabelRegression (PRS)
                generic_head = GenericHead(**head_args, name='generic_head') # Added name
                logits = generic_head(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)

        return logits

# --- Hyperparameter Definition ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Combines Quaero I's optimal hparams (from ID 909) and Praxis I's CRI-Off specific hparams
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'motif_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'head_intermediate_dim': 128,
        'weight_decay': 0.02, # For optimizer
        'grad_clip': 0.75, # For optimizer

        # CPE hparams (from Quaero I's ID 909)
        'pos_embedding_dim': 16,
        'context_window_size': 3,
        'max_overall_seq_len': 1200,
        'gate_intermediate_dim': 64,

        # Praxis I's hparams for Siamese Head
        'sgrna_len': 20, # Specific for CRI-Off slicing
        'siamese_head_dense_dim': 64, # From Praxis's model internal
    }

# --- Network and Optimizer Wrappers ---
class AetherNetworkWrapper: # Custom wrapper for my combined network
    def __init__(self, net_class, d_output, task_type, hparams: Dict[str, Any] = None):
        hp = hparams or {}
        self.net = net_class(d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type, hparams=hp)
        self.hparams = hp

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.net.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x_raw, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.net.apply({'params': params}, x_raw, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.net.apply({'params': params}, x_raw, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return AetherNetworkWrapper(
        net_class=Aether_QuaeroCPE_SiameseSynthesisNet,
        d_output=hparams.get('d_output', 1),
        task_type=hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'),
        hparams=hparams # Pass all hparams
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    # Use hparams defined above for weight_decay and grad_clip
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    weight_decay_value = hparams.get('weight_decay', 0.02)
    grad_clip_value = hparams.get('grad_clip', 0.75)

    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(grad_clip_value),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=weight_decay_value)
    )

## Root Cause
The original code had a syntax error on line 133 (original line number) in the `Aether_QuaeroCPE_SiameseSynthesisNet` class's `__call__` method. The error was:

```python
motif_f = nn.gelu(nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model_common'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME', name='motif_conv_for_pool'))(cnn_features)
```

The problem was that `nn.gelu()` was being applied to the `nn.Conv` layer object itself, rather than to the output of the convolution operation. This caused a `TypeError: gelu requires ndarray or scalar arguments, got <class 'flax.linen.linear.Conv'> at position 0`.

The error occurred because the parentheses were nested incorrectly - `nn.gelu()` was receiving the Conv layer as an argument instead of receiving the result of applying that Conv layer to `cnn_features`.

## Fix Applied
The fix was simple and straightforward - split the operation into two separate steps:

**Original (incorrect):**
```python
motif_f = nn.gelu(nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model_common'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME', name='motif_conv_for_pool'))(cnn_features)
```

**Fixed (correct):**
```python
motif_conv_output = nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model_common'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME', name='motif_conv_for_pool')(cnn_features)
motif_f = nn.gelu(motif_conv_output)
```

This ensures that:
1. First, the Conv layer is created and applied to `cnn_features`, producing `motif_conv_output` (a JAX array)
2. Then, `nn.gelu()` is applied to the array output, not the layer object

The fix maintains the exact same functionality as intended by the original code, just with correct syntax.

    dropout_rate: float = 0.1
    pos_embedding_dim: int = 16
    gate_intermediate_dim: int = 64

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        residual = x
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)

        # Standard DSConv operations
        dw_out = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
                         feature_group_count=self.d_model, padding='SAME',
                         kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,), name='dw_conv')(h)
        dw_out = nn.gelu(dw_out)
        h_conv_output = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(dw_out)
        # h_conv_output is now (batch, seq_len, d_model)

        # --- LEARNED GATING MECHANISM ---
        # 1. Project CPE signals to match d_model
        cpe_projected = nn.Dense(self.d_model, name='cpe_proj_for_gate')(self.cpe_signals)
        cpe_projected = nn.gelu(cpe_projected)

        # 2. Combine intermediate features (h_conv_output) and projected CPE
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([h_conv_output, cpe_projected], axis=-1)

        # 3. Gate Logic: Dense -> GELU -> Dense -> Sigmoid
        gate_input = nn.Dense(self.gate_intermediate_dim, name='gate_dense_1')(combined_features)
        gate_input = nn.gelu(gate_input)
        gate_output_raw = nn.Dense(self.d_model, name='gate_dense_2')(gate_input)
        gate_factor = nn.sigmoid(gate_output_raw) # Element-wise sigmoid activation

        # 4. Modulate the convolutional output
        modulated_h = h_conv_output * gate_factor
        # --- END LEARNED GATING ---

        # Apply dropout to the modulated features before residual add
        modulated_h_dropout = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(modulated_h, deterministic=deterministic)

        return residual + modulated_h_dropout

# --- Praxis I's SiameseInteractionHead (copied directly from ID 897) ---
class SiameseInteractionHead(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    dense_dim: int = 64
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1 # This will be set by global dropout_rate from hparams
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_sgrna, x_target, deterministic: bool = True):
        # x_sgrna and x_target are (batch, d_model)

        # Feature transformation (separate Dense layers for sgRNA and target)
        sgrna_proj = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='sgrna_proj')(x_sgrna)
        sgrna_proj = nn.gelu(sgrna_proj)
        sgrna_proj = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(sgrna_proj, deterministic=deterministic)

        target_proj = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='target_proj')(x_target)
        target_proj = nn.gelu(target_proj)
        target_proj = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(target_proj, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Interaction features: difference and product
        diff = jnp.abs(sgrna_proj - target_proj)
        prod = sgrna_proj * target_proj

        # Fuse interaction features
        interaction_features = jnp.concatenate([diff, prod], axis=-1) # (batch, 2 * dense_dim)
        interaction_features = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='interaction_fusion')(interaction_features)
        interaction_features = nn.gelu(interaction_features)
        interaction_features = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(interaction_features, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Final prediction
        logits = nn.Dense(1, name='output_logits')(interaction_features)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) # Squeeze for regression output

# --- Quaero I's Prediction Heads (for non-CRI-Off tasks) ---
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; dense_dim: int; dropout_rate: float; l2_norm_input: bool
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        if self.l2_norm_input:
            norm = jnp.linalg.norm(x, ord=2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            x = x / (norm + 1e-6)
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        return nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z).squeeze(-1)

class GenericHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; dense_dim: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        return nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)

# --- Main Network: Aether's Synthesis of Quaero + Praxis ---
class Aether_QuaeroCPE_SiameseSynthesisNet(nn.Module):
    # All hyperparameters from Quaero I's ID 909, plus Praxis I's specific ones
    d_output: int; task_type: str; hparams: Dict[str, Any]

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_raw, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Generate CPE signals once from the raw input (as in Quaero I)
        cpe_generator = CPE_Generator(
            d_input=x_raw.shape[-1], # 4
            pos_embedding_dim=self.hparams.get('pos_embedding_dim', 16),
            context_window_size=self.hparams.get('context_window_size', 3),
            max_overall_seq_len=self.hparams.get('max_overall_seq_len', 1200),
            name='cpe_generator'
        )
        cpe_signals = cpe_generator(x_raw)

        # 2. Initial Projection (as in Quaero I)
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model_common'], name="initial_dense")(x_raw)
        h = nn.gelu(h)

        # 3. CPE-Gated Residual Backbone (as in Quaero I)
        for i in range(self.hparams['ds_num_blocks']):
            dilation = self.hparams['ds_dilations'][i] if i < len(self.hparams['ds_dilations']) else self.hparams['ds_dilations'][-1]
            h = DeepCPE_Gated_ResidualDSConvBlock(
                d_model=self.hparams['d_model_common'], kernel_size=self.hparams['ds_kernel_size'],
                dilation=dilation, dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'],
                cpe_signals=cpe_signals, # Pass CPE signals here
                pos_embedding_dim=self.hparams.get('pos_embedding_dim', 16), # Also pass to gated block
                gate_intermediate_dim=self.hparams.get('gate_intermediate_dim', 64), # Also pass to gated block
                name=f"cpe_gated_block_{i}"
            )(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = h # Output of backbone: (batch, seq_len, d_model_common)

        # --- Conditional Head Application ---
        if self.task_type == "CRI-Off":
            # 4. Feature Extraction for Siamese Head
            sgrna_len = self.hparams['sgrna_len']
            # Ensure slicing is robust: assuming sgRNA is at the beginning of the sequence.
            sgRNA_sequence_features = cnn_features[:, :sgrna_len, :] # (batch, sgrna_len, d_model_common)
            target_sequence_features = cnn_features[:, sgrna_len:, :] # (batch, target_len, d_model_common)

            # Apply global mean pooling to get fixed-size representations
            pooled_sgrna_feat = jnp.mean(sgRNA_sequence_features, axis=1) # (batch, d_model_common)
            pooled_target_feat = jnp.mean(target_sequence_features, axis=1) # (batch, d_model_common)

            # 5. Apply Praxis I's SiameseInteractionHead
            siamese_head = SiameseInteractionHead(
                d_model=self.hparams['d_model_common'], # Input feature dim is d_model_common
                dense_dim=self.hparams.get('siamese_head_dense_dim', 64),
                dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'] # Use global dropout from Quaero
            )
            logits = siamese_head(pooled_sgrna_feat, pooled_target_feat, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            # 4. Dual-Path Pooling (as in Quaero I) - Only for non-CRI-Off tasks
            main_path = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1), jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)], axis=-1)
            # FIX: Split the Conv application and gelu activation into two separate steps
            motif_conv_output = nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model_common'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME', name='motif_conv_for_pool')(cnn_features)
            motif_f = nn.gelu(motif_conv_output)
            specialized_path = jnp.max(motif_f, axis=1)

            fused_features_for_generic_heads = jnp.concatenate([main_path, specialized_path], axis=-1)
            fused_features_for_generic_heads = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_fused_ln")(fused_features_for_generic_heads)
            fused_features_for_generic_heads = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)

            # 5. Task-Specific Heads (as in Quaero I)
            head_args = {
                'd_output': self.d_output,
                'dense_dim': self.hparams['head_intermediate_dim'],
                'dropout_rate': self.hparams['dropout_rate']
            }
            if self.task_type == "regression": # For simple regression (APA, CRI-On, MRL)
                regression_head = RegressionHead(**head_args, l2_norm_input=True, name='regression_head') # Added name
                logits = regression_head(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)
            else: # For MultiLabelClassification (Modif, ncRNA) and MultiLabelRegression (PRS)
                generic_head = GenericHead(**head_args, name='generic_head') # Added name
                logits = generic_head(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)

        return logits

# --- Hyperparameter Definition ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Combines Quaero I's optimal hparams (from ID 909) and Praxis I's CRI-Off specific hparams
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'motif_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'head_intermediate_dim': 128,
        'weight_decay': 0.02, # For optimizer
        'grad_clip': 0.75, # For optimizer

        # CPE hparams (from Quaero I's ID 909)
        'pos_embedding_dim': 16,
        'context_window_size': 3,
        'max_overall_seq_len': 1200,
        'gate_intermediate_dim': 64,

        # Praxis I's hparams for Siamese Head
        'sgrna_len': 20, # Specific for CRI-Off slicing
        'siamese_head_dense_dim': 64, # From Praxis's model internal
    }

# --- Network and Optimizer Wrappers ---
class AetherNetworkWrapper: # Custom wrapper for my combined network
    def __init__(self, net_class, d_output, task_type, hparams: Dict[str, Any] = None):
        hp = hparams or {}
        self.net = net_class(d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type, hparams=hp)
        self.hparams = hp

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.net.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x_raw, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.net.apply({'params': params}, x_raw, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.net.apply({'params': params}, x_raw, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return AetherNetworkWrapper(
        net_class=Aether_QuaeroCPE_SiameseSynthesisNet,
        d_output=hparams.get('d_output', 1),
        task_type=hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'),
        hparams=hparams # Pass all hparams
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    # Use hparams defined above for weight_decay and grad_clip
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    weight_decay_value = hparams.get('weight_decay', 0.02)
    grad_clip_value = hparams.get('grad_clip', 0.75)

    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(grad_clip_value),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=weight_decay_value)
    )

        residual = x
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)

        # Standard DSConv operations
        dw_out = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
                         feature_group_count=self.d_model, padding='SAME',
                         kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,), name='dw_conv')(h)
        dw_out = nn.gelu(dw_out)
        h_conv_output = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(dw_out)
        # h_conv_output is now (batch, seq_len, d_model)

        # --- LEARNED GATING MECHANISM ---
        # 1. Project CPE signals to match d_model
        cpe_projected = nn.Dense(self.d_model, name='cpe_proj_for_gate')(self.cpe_signals)
        cpe_projected = nn.gelu(cpe_projected)

        # 2. Combine intermediate features (h_conv_output) and projected CPE
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([h_conv_output, cpe_projected], axis=-1)

        # 3. Gate Logic: Dense -> GELU -> Dense -> Sigmoid
        gate_input = nn.Dense(self.gate_intermediate_dim, name='gate_dense_1')(combined_features)
        gate_input = nn.gelu(gate_input)
        gate_output_raw = nn.Dense(self.d_model, name='gate_dense_2')(gate_input)
        gate_factor = nn.sigmoid(gate_output_raw) # Element-wise sigmoid activation

        # 4. Modulate the convolutional output
        modulated_h = h_conv_output * gate_factor
        # --- END LEARNED GATING ---

        # Apply dropout to the modulated features before residual add
        modulated_h_dropout = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(modulated_h, deterministic=deterministic)

        return residual + modulated_h_dropout

# --- Praxis I's SiameseInteractionHead (copied directly from ID 897) ---
class SiameseInteractionHead(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    dense_dim: int = 64
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1 # This will be set by global dropout_rate from hparams
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_sgrna, x_target, deterministic: bool = True):
        # x_sgrna and x_target are (batch, d_model)

        # Feature transformation (separate Dense layers for sgRNA and target)
        sgrna_proj = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='sgrna_proj')(x_sgrna)
        sgrna_proj = nn.gelu(sgrna_proj)
        sgrna_proj = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(sgrna_proj, deterministic=deterministic)

        target_proj = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='target_proj')(x_target)
        target_proj = nn.gelu(target_proj)
        target_proj = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(target_proj, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Interaction features: difference and product
        diff = jnp.abs(sgrna_proj - target_proj)
        prod = sgrna_proj * target_proj

        # Fuse interaction features
        interaction_features = jnp.concatenate([diff, prod], axis=-1) # (batch, 2 * dense_dim)
        interaction_features = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='interaction_fusion')(interaction_features)
        interaction_features = nn.gelu(interaction_features)
        interaction_features = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(interaction_features, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Final prediction
        logits = nn.Dense(1, name='output_logits')(interaction_features)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) # Squeeze for regression output

# --- Quaero I's Prediction Heads (for non-CRI-Off tasks) ---
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; dense_dim: int; dropout_rate: float; l2_norm_input: bool
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        if self.l2_norm_input:
            norm = jnp.linalg.norm(x, ord=2, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
            x = x / (norm + 1e-6)
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        return nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z).squeeze(-1)

class GenericHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; dense_dim: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x); z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        return nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)

# --- Main Network: Aether's Synthesis of Quaero + Praxis ---
class Aether_QuaeroCPE_SiameseSynthesisNet(nn.Module):
    # All hyperparameters from Quaero I's ID 909, plus Praxis I's specific ones
    d_output: int; task_type: str; hparams: Dict[str, Any]

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x_raw, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Generate CPE signals once from the raw input (as in Quaero I)
        cpe_generator = CPE_Generator(
            d_input=x_raw.shape[-1], # 4
            pos_embedding_dim=self.hparams.get('pos_embedding_dim', 16),
            context_window_size=self.hparams.get('context_window_size', 3),
            max_overall_seq_len=self.hparams.get('max_overall_seq_len', 1200),
            name='cpe_generator'
        )
        cpe_signals = cpe_generator(x_raw)

        # 2. Initial Projection (as in Quaero I)
        h = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model_common'], name="initial_dense")(x_raw)
        h = nn.gelu(h)

        # 3. CPE-Gated Residual Backbone (as in Quaero I)
        for i in range(self.hparams['ds_num_blocks']):
            dilation = self.hparams['ds_dilations'][i] if i < len(self.hparams['ds_dilations']) else self.hparams['ds_dilations'][-1]
            h = DeepCPE_Gated_ResidualDSConvBlock(
                d_model=self.hparams['d_model_common'], kernel_size=self.hparams['ds_kernel_size'],
                dilation=dilation, dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'],
                cpe_signals=cpe_signals, # Pass CPE signals here
                pos_embedding_dim=self.hparams.get('pos_embedding_dim', 16), # Also pass to gated block
                gate_intermediate_dim=self.hparams.get('gate_intermediate_dim', 64), # Also pass to gated block
                name=f"cpe_gated_block_{i}"
            )(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = h # Output of backbone: (batch, seq_len, d_model_common)

        # --- Conditional Head Application ---
        if self.task_type == "CRI-Off":
            # 4. Feature Extraction for Siamese Head
            sgrna_len = self.hparams['sgrna_len']
            # Ensure slicing is robust: assuming sgRNA is at the beginning of the sequence.
            sgRNA_sequence_features = cnn_features[:, :sgrna_len, :] # (batch, sgrna_len, d_model_common)
            target_sequence_features = cnn_features[:, sgrna_len:, :] # (batch, target_len, d_model_common)

            # Apply global mean pooling to get fixed-size representations
            pooled_sgrna_feat = jnp.mean(sgRNA_sequence_features, axis=1) # (batch, d_model_common)
            pooled_target_feat = jnp.mean(target_sequence_features, axis=1) # (batch, d_model_common)

            # 5. Apply Praxis I's SiameseInteractionHead
            siamese_head = SiameseInteractionHead(
                d_model=self.hparams['d_model_common'], # Input feature dim is d_model_common
                dense_dim=self.hparams.get('siamese_head_dense_dim', 64),
                dropout_rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'] # Use global dropout from Quaero
            )
            logits = siamese_head(pooled_sgrna_feat, pooled_target_feat, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            # 4. Dual-Path Pooling (as in Quaero I) - Only for non-CRI-Off tasks
            main_path = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1), jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)], axis=-1)
            # FIX: Split the Conv application and gelu activation into two separate steps
            motif_conv_output = nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model_common'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],), padding='SAME', name='motif_conv_for_pool')(cnn_features)
            motif_f = nn.gelu(motif_conv_output)
            specialized_path = jnp.max(motif_f, axis=1)

            fused_features_for_generic_heads = jnp.concatenate([main_path, specialized_path], axis=-1)
            fused_features_for_generic_heads = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_fused_ln")(fused_features_for_generic_heads)
            fused_features_for_generic_heads = nn.Dropout(rate=self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)

            # 5. Task-Specific Heads (as in Quaero I)
            head_args = {
                'd_output': self.d_output,
                'dense_dim': self.hparams['head_intermediate_dim'],
                'dropout_rate': self.hparams['dropout_rate']
            }
            if self.task_type == "regression": # For simple regression (APA, CRI-On, MRL)
                regression_head = RegressionHead(**head_args, l2_norm_input=True, name='regression_head') # Added name
                logits = regression_head(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)
            else: # For MultiLabelClassification (Modif, ncRNA) and MultiLabelRegression (PRS)
                generic_head = GenericHead(**head_args, name='generic_head') # Added name
                logits = generic_head(fused_features_for_generic_heads, deterministic=deterministic)

        return logits

# --- Hyperparameter Definition ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Combines Quaero I's optimal hparams (from ID 909) and Praxis I's CRI-Off specific hparams
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'motif_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'head_intermediate_dim': 128,
        'weight_decay': 0.02, # For optimizer
        'grad_clip': 0.75, # For optimizer

        # CPE hparams (from Quaero I's ID 909)
        'pos_embedding_dim': 16,
        'context_window_size': 3,
        'max_overall_seq_len': 1200,
        'gate_intermediate_dim': 64,

        # Praxis I's hparams for Siamese Head
        'sgrna_len': 20, # Specific for CRI-Off slicing
        'siamese_head_dense_dim': 64, # From Praxis's model internal
    }

# --- Network and Optimizer Wrappers ---
class AetherNetworkWrapper: # Custom wrapper for my combined network
    def __init__(self, net_class, d_output, task_type, hparams: Dict[str, Any] = None):
        hp = hparams or {}
        self.net = net_class(d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type, hparams=hp)
        self.hparams = hp

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.net.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x_raw, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.net.apply({'params': params}, x_raw, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.net.apply({'params': params}, x_raw, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return AetherNetworkWrapper(
        net_class=Aether_QuaeroCPE_SiameseSynthesisNet,
        d_output=hparams.get('d_output', 1),
        task_type=hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'),
        hparams=hparams # Pass all hparams
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    # Use hparams defined above for weight_decay and grad_clip
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    weight_decay_value = hparams.get('weight_decay', 0.02)
    grad_clip_value = hparams.get('grad_clip', 0.75)

    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(grad_clip_value),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=weight_decay_value)
    )
